description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sol Ring, adding {C}{C}.
Sol Ring leaves the battlefield, triggering Sly Requisitioner, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
The Servo dies, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
